description: This file contains utility functions for handling sandbox paths, URL and file path normalization, validation, and resolution within a sandboxed environment, specifically for managing media sources and path security in a sandboxed context.

methods.name: normalizeUnicodeSpaces
methods.description: Replaces Unicode space characters in a string with regular spaces.

methods.name: normalizeAtPrefix
methods.description: Removes '@' prefix from a file path if present.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a path, handling '~' for home directory and Unicode spaces.

methods.name: resolveToCwd
methods.description: Resolves a given path relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: resolveSandboxInputPath
methods.description: Resolves a sandbox input path relative to a given current working directory.

methods.name: resolveSandboxPath
methods.description: Resolves a path within the sandbox and computes its relative path to the sandbox root.

methods.name: assertSandboxPath
methods.description: Validates and resolves a sandbox path, ensuring it does not escape the sandbox root.

methods.name: assertMediaNotDataUrl
methods.description: Throws an error if the media string is a data URL.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedMediaSource
methods.description: Resolves a media source URL or path within the sandbox, handling file URLs, HTTP URLs, and local paths.
